officialText: Textile wall and ceiling coverings and expanded vinyl wall and ceiling coverings shall have a Class A flame spread index per Section 803.1.1 of this code; shall meet the smoke developed index requirements of Section 803.1.1; and shall be protected by an automatic sprinkler system installed in accordance with Section 903.3.1.1 or 903.3.1.2 of this code. Test specimen preparation and mounting shall be in accordance with ASTM E 2404.
